title: Just One More
description: This is just a small mod that makes it so when you craft 4 logs into wood it will give you 4 insted of 3.
body:
# Just One More
This is just a simple mod to give you **4 wood insted of 3 when crafting** as shown in the pictures below. This mod will probably wont recive updates often and if their is updates they will probaly be small fixes or upgrading versions to newer updates or loaders.

![Oak Wood](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8da73ad6116c5d9dddb72b3274728fbbb80a5e6f.png)
![Stripped Oak Wood](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29dc2915c74d504757f6828016a87b750cefa23f.png)
![Cherry Wood](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba407f6787c3e19fde01a604f6bd72a279d3770d.png)![Stripped Cherry Wood](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3137a0753094cb25d5b05f2d9c7901cba1969a2a.png)

## Extra Info
This is obviously not all the crafting recipes as this mod covers all of them making sure you get what you ask for. The only other feature I might add to this mod is being able to craft wood back into logs but for now this is the only feature.

## Supported Loaders
- Forge - **Might if people like the mod enough**
- NeoForge - **Yes**
- Fabric - **Yes**
- Quilt - **No**

## Questions/Suggestions

(**FORGE ONLY**) - If there are any questions or suggestions, just add them to the comments, and I will see what I can do.

**THIS MOD WAS MADE USING MCREATOR**
